rationale: The approved durable UR supports classification, but compact_delivery is ineligible because completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are not evidenced. verified_change is also ineligible because there are three canonical owners and derived-path propagation is not deterministic. The bounded product-semantics correction has no runtime, policy, persistence, architecture, security, API, CLI, release, or cross-host impact, so structured_slice is the proportional candidate rather than structured_delivery.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is visibly approved for measurement.
No completed Brownfield analysis is supplied.
No stored quick_task context is supplied.
Three canonical owners and three source paths require scoped cross-owner coordination.
Four derived paths exist and deterministic propagation is false.
Runtime, policy, persistence, architecture, security, external API, CLI contract, release, and cross-host impacts areall
